# Contract
- Every path you read or write is absolute under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin unless it is a public URL. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin/<that path>. Extra files only under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-24/w2/<YourSeatName>/. A relative path would land in the fleet repo; never write there.
- Never edit production lane files or committed evidence. Never run git or jj write commands in the lane (add, commit, stash, checkout, switch, reset, pull, push, new, describe, squash, rebase, abandon, bookmark, undo, fetch); read-only git is fine. Mutation tests and anything that writes git objects run only in your own clone: `git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/tsuku24w2-<YourSeatName>/lane` then `git -C ... checkout -q 22fd1642e7fa4dfbdfba4419a443f06ffbb0b6c0`; mutate there, run, record pristine → mutant → restored results. Never touch the fleet repo outside /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin, sibling lanes, MANIFEST.json, .ufo/state or the lane jj state.
- Host actions are read-only. You and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in your report). pacman guard: all pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide; install only via `uv tool`, `npx` or an official binary in ~/.local/bin, or report the need. Never run pacman -S, -Sy, -Syu, -U, -R, -Scc, paccache without -d, a downgrade, a service restart, a configuration write, a boot or an image rebuild. Read-only queries (pacman -Q*, -Si/-Sl on existing databases, checkupdates with CHECKUPDATES_DB under /fast/scratch, journalctl, stat, findmnt, curl of public URLs) are fine.
- Privacy: never copy secrets, tokens, environment dumps or raw configuration files; reduce working directories to inside or outside the fleet repo.
- Report format: plain English, no run-together words, no private shorthand. First line: a verdict naming exactly what you attacked and whether it survived (`survives`, `survives with defects`, `falsified`). Then numbered findings, each with an evidence pointer (absolute path:line, URL plus quote, or command plus exit code and output excerpt), marked [obs], [inf] or [unk]. Give the smallest correction for each defect. End with the literal lines `Scope: read=<summary>; wrote=<paths>; executed=<commands or none>` and `Installs: none` (or each install).
- You are a leaf: no delegation, no background jobs, no swarm. Never pass a model parameter.
